zip.readme:
# {title}

This is your site from the era “{era}” of the textbook “Through Time”.

## How to publish it

**GitHub Pages.** Create a repository on github.com, upload these files, then under Settings, Pages, choose the main branch. A minute later the site opens at an address like name.github.io/repository.

**Netlify.** Go to app.netlify.com/drop and drag the folder with these files into the window.

**Vercel.** Create a project on vercel.com, choose “Other” and upload the folder.

**Any ordinary host.** Any hosting that serves static files will do (a plan for simple sites is enough): upload the files to the public_html folder with the host’s file manager or over SFTP.
